ruling.recommended_action: Refer to Ryde trust & safety for urgent human review: contact the rider for a statement (offer RydeHELP / 995 / police reporting path if she wishes), review the in-car audio/telematics and the driver's record, and consider interim account suspension pending investigation. + flag_account
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen first. The complaint alleges the driver threatened to lock the rider in when she asked to get out; the chat corroborates it — rider at 17:09: "Please stop the car, I want to get out here" [F3], driver at 17:10: "Sit down or I lock the doors" [F4]. That is a threat/intimidation aimed at the other party, read in context and not as a pickup arrangement; it also alleges the rider was not permitted to leave the vehicle. Under SAFE-1 (and the code-of-conduct bar on abuse of any kind) the case is at least "suspected"; the rider also states she "felt unsafe for the whole ride", which is an intimidation/unsafe-confinement allegation the judge cannot settle. Per the safety screen no automatic ruling is issued.

Secondary observation, not a ruling: the driver's statement [F6] and the rider's chats conflict on what happened (his account frames it as a safety instruction and denies threatening), so nothing here can be resolved by records alone; the trip itself shows no route deviation (actual 15.4 km vs optimal 15.5 km, -0.1 km [F1]; +1.9 min [F2]), so no RD analysis is needed.

Evidence: the chat is complete and timestamped (2 messages, both timestamped) [F5]; no evidence gap on the safety question itself, but the underlying event can only be assessed by a human reviewer, hence escalate rather than a merits ruling on any fare item. Profiles [F7][F8] show no prior disputes by either party (driver 0 upheld, rider 0 upheld) and cannot decide anything on their own.

The driver's own account confirms the rider attempted to exit the vehicle during the ride and he drove on [F6], which together with [F4] is a matter for Ryde's trust & safety team and potentially the authorities — flagged for account review.
ruling.escalation_reason: Dispute type is safety and the record contains a threat/intimidation allegation (driver: "Sit down or I lock the doors" in response to the rider asking to get out), which SAFE-1 requires be handled by a human reviewer rather than decided automatically. No fare ruling is issued; the rider's statement, driver statement, in-car audio and telematics should be reviewed, and the driver's account flagged.
